summary: Frontend-only regression + bug-fix verification for Xenon Ophthalmics marketing site. Verified navbar-over-dark-hero readability (light logo/link text at top), scrolled 'glass' state switching to dark logo/dark link text, theme toggle persistence to localStorage 'xo-theme' with document root class updates, dark-mode navbar remains light in both top and scrolled states, homepage marquee removal, all hero/product/nav CTAs, demo form submission, and all 11 routes render without runtime errors. 28/28 checks PASSED.

issues: Console warning from framer-motion useScroll: 'ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' — appears on multiple pages using useScroll. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up by ensuring parent/target container has position: relative.

action_items: (Optional) Silence framer-motion scroll target warning by ensuring the useScroll target container (Hero section and any other useScroll targets) has an explicit non-static position. The Hero uses `.relative` already; the warning likely originates from a different useScroll usage — audit and add `relative` where missing.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar readability logic `light = !scrolled || theme === 'dark'` correctly handles the dark-hero-at-top requirement — verified visually and via computed styles.
ThemeProvider correctly persists 'xo-theme' and toggles root class between 'light' and 'dark'. Default is 'light'. Works as spec.
Home.jsx no longer renders the Scheduling/Examination/Fitting/Finishing marquee — text still appears in the hero paragraph copy but no scrolling crawl element exists (0 marquee elements found).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All bug-fix items in this iteration (navbar readability over dark hero, theme toggle w/ persistence, marquee removal, hero/nav/product CTAs, demo form, all-route render) pass. Only cosmetic non-blocking console warning about framer-motion useScroll target positioning remains.
